FEATURED_VIDEOS.title: Kuruwitu Conservation Story
FEATURED_VIDEOS.description: How a small fishing village became a global model for community-led ocean conservation.

FEATURED_VIDEOS.title: Coral Restoration in Action
FEATURED_VIDEOS.description: Watch fishers transform into reef gardeners, planting 25,000+ corals across 39 hectares.

FEATURED_VIDEOS.title: Women Leading Change
FEATURED_VIDEOS.description: 735+ women building climate-smart livelihoods through Trash4Cash and permaculture.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Kenya's Kuruwitu Corals Are Back, Thanks to Local Conservation Drive
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: 30% coral recovery, 400% fish biomass increase. "More than 30 community conservation initiatives along the Kenyan coast trace their inspiration back to Kuruwitu."

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: How King Charles III's Visit to Kuruwitu Conservation Unravelled
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: King Charles III visits Kuruwitu in November 2023, launches "King's Coral Village" structure with 40 coral plugs. Global recognition follows.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Kuruwitu Conservation & Welfare Association Partnership
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: KCWA and Oceans Alive partnership with Blue Ventures focuses on strengthening Beach Management Units for improved fisheries management since 2016.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Indian Ocean Kenya Coral Restoration Project
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: Collaboration with Oceans Alive Foundation on REEL Kilifi project since 2024. Strengthening participatory coral reef restoration across 12,000-hectare Kuruwitu area.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: How Coastal Community is Restoring Degraded Coral and Reviving Economy
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: Oceans Alive has planted over 15,000 new corals. Canon sponsorship supports nursery tables and reef infrastructure for thousands more fragments.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: New East Africa Initiative Targets Coral Reef Restoration in Kenya
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: Coverage of new coral reef restoration initiatives in Kenya, highlighting Kuruwitu's pioneering community-led approach.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Oceans Alive: A Community-Led Model for Marine Recovery
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: In-depth feature on Oceans Alive's community-led conservation model and its impact on marine recovery in Kilifi County.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Equator Prize Winners 2021: Local Action Solutions
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: Kuruwitu among global winners recognized for innovative nature-based solutions. $10,000 prize and participation in UN General Assembly events.

EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.title: Hosting Kenya's First Community-Led Marine Protected Area
EXTERNAL_ARTICLES.excerpt: Feature on Vipingo Ridge hosting Kuruwitu Conservation offices and the historic role of Kenya's first community-led MPA.
